scope: 12h joint skill PPO LoRA pilot, authorized evaluations
environment: LIBERO-PRO custom skill resets over libero_10 task 6
precision: bf16 frozen VLM/action backbone; fp32 norm/stem/action/value heads and LoRA adapters
algorithm: Synchronous Flow-SDE PPO; 3-GPU globally weighted gradient reduction, one central AdamW step per on-policy batch
decision_status: User edits plus accepted recommendations; latest instruction 3h checkpoints/evaluation, 12h wall budget
gripper_mapping: Pass through official pi05_libero native continuous action; no GAWM probability inversion
lr_schedule: 3 critic-only updates; actor linear warmup10 updates then constant
formal_update_scope: rank16 alpha16 LoRA on action-expert QKVO and gated FFN, plus full critic; frozen base
gpu_binding: CUDA UUID whitelist and EGL_CUDA_DEVICE_NV enumeration, not raw physical index
full_resume: exact optimizer/RNG/update-boundary resume; environments deliberately reset at each update; no mid-episode resume
curriculum: 0-1h mugs;1-3h mugs+moka;3-12h all long movable object types; tilt severity grows 60 to90deg
batch_numerics: Preserve original 8-env sampling groups and order in PPO gradient microbatches; no mixed batch regrouping
clearance_reference: EEF to object center >=0.10m, plus released/open and actual support; approach shaping retains center+0.05m reference
demo_warmup: 32 physical scripted recovery attempts, 0 validated successful demonstrations; no BC warmup or failed-demo training
upright_eligible_types: all long movable types except book,plate,frying pan,cream cheese,butter,chocolate pudding,basket; flat items still trained for pick/place
no_progress_policy: run bounded 12h pilot, do not silently alter rewards/learning rates; nonfinite, logprob mismatch, excessive post-update KL stop and trigger bounded recovery
